g.title: displacement
g.text: DISPLACEMENT NETWORK core map — population: VERBS ONLY (795 coupled pairs, 419 words).
Top-2 receivers per faller at lift >= 3, fragments filtered.
Edges are displacement-coupled and split-half certified; labels are shrunken full-data lift.
Basin colours are a READING, an editorial layer, not a computed property; the sink lists behind them are computed (purity >= 0.9, in-degree >= 5).
Lifts are NOT comparable across populations: the verb restriction compresses them to roughly half.
